hook.en: One cook in a small kitchen is slow, three are efficient, but ten cooks in the same kitchen get in each other's way. That is the law of *variable proportions*.

title.en: State the law of diminishing marginal product and variable proportions
Relate the shapes of TP, AP and MP curves

say.en: One cook in a small kitchen is slow, three are efficient, but ten cooks in the same kitchen get in each other's way. That is the law of variable proportions. In this lesson: State the law of diminishing marginal product and variable proportions.
Explain the three phases.
Relate the shapes of TP, AP and MP curves.

body.en: The law of diminishing marginal product says that if we keep increasing one input with other inputs fixed, its marginal product eventually starts falling. The law of *variable proportions* describes the full pattern: at first MP rises (increasing returns to the factor), because the fixed factor is under-used; then MP falls but stays positive (diminishing returns); finally MP becomes negative and TP falls (negative returns), because the fixed factor is overcrowded.

points.en: Phase 1: MP rises, TP rises at an increasing rate
Phase 2: MP falls but > 0, TP rises at a diminishing rate

narration.en: When more and more of one input is added to fixed inputs, its marginal product first rises, then falls, and finally becomes negative.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಆದಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಆದಾನವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸೇರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅದರ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಮೊದಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ನಂತರ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: When more and more of one input is added to fixed inputs, its marginal product first rises, then falls, and finally becomes negative. Phase 1: MP rises, TP rises at an increasing rate.
say.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ಆದಾನಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದು ಆದಾನವನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸೇರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಅದರ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಮೊದಲು ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ, ನಂತರ ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Phase 2: MP falls but is greater than 0, TP rises at a diminishing rate.
Phase 3: MP is less than 0, TP falls.

body.en: MP and AP *curves* are inverse-U shaped. TP rises at an increasing rate while MP rises, at a decreasing rate while MP falls but is positive, is maximum when MP = 0, and falls when MP < 0. When MP > AP, AP rises; when MP < AP, AP falls; so MP cuts AP at AP's maximum. A rational producer operates in phase 2.

narration.en: MP and AP are inverse-U shaped. MP cuts AP at AP's highest point, and TP is maximum when MP is zero.
narration.kn: ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಮತ್ತು ಸರಾಸರಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಗಳು ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾದ U ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಸರಾಸರಿ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನದ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಅದನ್ನು ಛೇದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಸೀಮಾಂತ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಶೂನ್ಯವಾದಾಗ ಒಟ್ಟು ಉತ್ಪನ್ನ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ.

problem.en: TP of labour for 1 to 7 workers is 10, 24, 36, 44, 48, 48, 45. Identify the three phases of the law of variable proportions.

steps.en: Phase 2 (MP falling but ≥ 0): 3rd to 6th worker (12, 8, 4, 0); TP is maximum at 6 workers.
Phase 3 (MP negative): 7th worker (−3); TP falls to 45.

answer.en: Phase 1: up to 2 workers; Phase 2: 3 to 6 workers; Phase 3: from the 7th worker.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. TP of labour for 1 to 7 workers is 10, 24, 36, 44, 48, 48, 45. Identify the three phases of the law of variable proportions.

say.en: Let us work this out together. TP of labour for 1 to 7 workers is 10, 24, 36, 44, 48, 48, 45. Identify the three phases of the law of variable proportions.
MP equals 10, 14, 12, 8, 4, 0, minus 3.
Phase 1 MP rising: 1st to 2nd worker 10 gives 14.
Phase 2 (MP falling but is greater than or equal to 0): 3rd to 6th worker (12, 8, 4, 0); TP is maximum at 6 workers.
Phase 3 MP negative: 7th worker minus 3; TP falls to 45.
So the answer is Phase 1: up to 2 workers; Phase 2: 3 to 6 workers; Phase 3: from the 7th worker.
